change: accuracy-preserving harness engineering: replace the redundant search tool-echo LLM call in law_search_agent.run_search with a direct handler call (typed direct dispatch). Search args are already fixed by the preparation stage.
why_accuracy_preserving: the sole tool is search_laws and its arguments (country/keywords/search_terms) are fully determined before the call; the LLM only re-emits them, so calling the handler directly yields the same search

accuracy.note: the single difference is a case where gpt-oss's echo drifted from the intended args; the direct path uses exactly the preparation output, so it is the more faithful path. Reranker was HTTP 401 (auth) for both arms, matching current production.

applies_to: src/agent/law_search_agent.py run_search (see integrations/2025-moleg-search/README.md for the exact replacement snippet)
deployment: not deployed to production; provided as a verified candidate change for the team's k8s deploy process
